messages:
alex: FYI - multiple customers report edge runtime crash after upgrading SDK to 3.2.0-canary. Repro + trace below.

alex: Stack:
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'call')
    at Object.registerAuth (node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/index.js:12:45)
    at createHandler (node_modules/redwood-inference/dist/edge-runtime.js:34:12)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```

sophia: Which bundler/runtime?

alex: Vercel Edge (esbuild), Bun edge, local Deno. Happens only when bundler tree-shakes side-effect modules (prod builds). dev (CJS/node) ok.

jamie: Quick guess: our init code that patches fetch/auth is in a module imported for side effects and got pruned. Can you paste package.json exports?

alex: snippet:
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  }
},
"sideEffects": false
```

kevin: Yep — sideEffects:false + no direct import means bundlers can drop it. We used `import './init'` from index.mjs but the optimizer saw no live bindings referencing it and removed it during tree-shake.

sophia: Oof. Two fixes: mark the init file as side-effectful in package.json or explicitly export an init function consumers must call. Also docs to tell edge users to `import 'redwood-inference/register'`.

jamie: Proposed package fix (canary): add `\"sideEffects\": [\"./dist/register.mjs\"]` and ensure `index.mjs` imports `./register.mjs` (so it isn't pruned) OR make register a named export used by default export. Which do we prefer?

alex: Short term: publish canary with sideEffects whitelist. Long term: make init explicit and add runtime guard that throws with clear message if not registered.

sophia: Runtime guard example:
```
if (!globalThis.__RW_INFERENCE_INIT) {
  throw new Error('Redwood Inference not initialized. Import "redwood-inference/register" in your app entry.');
}
```

kevin: I'll open a PR with the package.json change + docs update. Jamie can you own the runtime guard PR? I'll also add a failing unit test that simulates esbuild tree-shaking.

ci-bot: Created issue #3421: "edge builds drop register side-effect -> runtime crash" and assigned to kevin/jamie

alex: Workaround for customers: add `import 'redwood-inference/register'` at top of _app.tsx / edge entry, or pin to 3.1.x

sophia: Good. Add changelog note and update migration guide. :thumbsup:

jamie: I'll also add a quick E2E with Vercel integration in our devex repo so we catch regressions.

alex: Thanks — let's get the canary out today.
